failure_summary: A5 fails 5/5 (deterministic): render_decision.zones.aliases roles literally read 'the one at c6r5'/'the one at c3r5' and link.text says 'completing at c6r5 ... deny it at c3r5', so 4/5 runs echo raw cNrM into coach prose even though the assembled prompt orders 'Never write a raw square' (OI-194), and the 5th (run 3) dodges it only by echoing the field name 'that late resource'; the same render block also sets a contradiction — the L5/O1 frame says the win is 'too far to pin to a single square' while requiredSet MANDATES naming c6r5 and c3r5.
notes: Sub-sampling per rubric: A3/A4/G2/G4/G5 graded on runs 0-1 only, null elsewhere; A5/A6/A7/G1/G3/G6/G7 graded on all 5. A1/A2/A6 copied verbatim from *_mechanical.json (eval-9|D|0..4). Board truth: movestring 33322226, you=P1, better col 7 (solver +1), played col 6 (0) — win_to_draw confirmed by ./visualize_board.sh. G4: lostResource.finalMovestring 33322226664420600000211111313344445556655 ends move 41 = Y at c6r5 completing row 5 c3r5,c4r5,c5r5,c6r5 — the named cell and window are engine-true; opponentPunishment.finalMovestring 3332222652 puts O on c3r5 — the denial claim is engine-true. A5 fail run 0: 'square at c6r5' / 'square at c3r5' raw notation. A5 fail run 1: 'square at c3r5', 'The square at c6r5'. A5 fail run 2: 'answer later at c3r5', 'key square at c6r5', plus 'your long-term parity resource' (prose echo of lostResource). A5 fail run 3: no raw square but 'takes away that late resource' echoes lostResource. A5 fail run 4: 'finish on c6r5', 'answer on c3r5'. A6 fail runs 0 and 2 (mechanical): run 0 wraps [zone:col7] around 'book move' and never writes the digit 7; run 2 says only 'play the book move' with no col7 zone at all while naming column 6 — a player is told which column was WRONG and not which was right. Production's mentionsBetterColumn retry would have re-rolled both; the harness calls once (OI-183), so this is partly an eval artifact — but the generation defect is real. A4 fail run 1: 'played the central book move in column 7' — column 7 is the rightmost edge column, and openingContext.centralityComparison.qualitative is null while the guardrail explicitly forbids calling a column more central; run 4 repeats it ('book central-column move at column 7') but A4 was not scored on run 4. The proximate render contribution is the opening family name 'central-column opening' printed two lines above 'Better move: column 7'. G7 fail run 3: membership passed (mechanical G7a/G7b pass, annotationRepairs empty) but the run emits only [zone:future:windows:...] and drops BOTH required single-square handles you-key-square (c6r5) and you-key-square-2 (c3r5) that the prompt's 'You MUST build the explanation around these' block lists — again a case production's retry would have caught (OI-183). A7 passes 5/5: the mechanism is not a fork (A7c N/A), referents are locatable via the emitted zones, and every run names an idea (leave/keep the book line, the row-5 group decides it later) plus the squares instantiating it. G3 pass: afterBest is shown:false because its tag set equals the decision board's, and no run needed it. G5 pass: the only rendered tactic, 'major at c5r2 (you)' on afterPlayed, is board-true (Y on c6r1,c4r3,c3r4 with c5r2 empty). G6 pass: patternOnAfterBestBoard null matches the after-best board, which visualize_board reports with no major threats. Intermittency: the decisive A5 failure is 5/5 deterministic; A6 (2/5) and G7 (1/5) are intermittent. MODEL REGIME: these rows are gpt-5.4-mini, the production model, so this is a production-fidelity run — none of the model-side lapses above can be separated from model capability, which is why the decisive triage is the model-independent render defect (raw cNrM handed to the model in alias roles and link text).
